scope: Harness preparation and next integration dependencies, not acceptance of teammate implementations

checked_pull_requests.decision: Keep current default baseline. Local confirmation remains opt-in; historical negative gate ties at 98 frames and 88 episodes.
Do not promote from historical counts. Exact rebased branch is not fully evaluated; long or structure-attached obstacles remain a suppression risk.

Use this existing contour-label implementation for subsequent boundary-panel integration rather than duplicating it. Reported smoke has 13 conditional edge cases and zero confirmed edge hazards; no acceptance claimed here.
Prefer existing ROS contract candidate for integration. No target Docker/Humble/RViz runtime acceptance exists in the PR; verify before release.

remaining_critical_limits: Default detector has zero exact-provenance intersection-confirmed frames for synthetic low event9 and thin event10 in the retained baseline.
Person presence on36 frames is not evidence of a real on-track collision hazard; full-person-volume localization and observed-return support differ.
Extrapolation uncertainty is heuristic; fitting residuals do not independently measure anchor association, railhead identity or extrinsic error.
Negative evaluation partition was previously inspected; not a blind holdout.
ROS target runtime, actual demo display, sustained input-rate handling and sensor-to-display latency remain separate acceptance tasks.
modifications_to_teammate_work: None. No branch or other worktree modified.
